sources.page_title: Get Deployments | VM Apps Org - Deployment
sources.contract_facts: The name query requires an exact deployment name match; a 200 response is PageDeployment with a content array containing deployment id and name.

sources.page_title: Submit Deployment Action Request | VM Apps Org - Deployment
sources.contract_facts: The required JSON body is ResourceActionRequest with actionId, inputs and reason; a 200 response is a Request containing id, deploymentId, actionId and status.

sources.page_title: Get Request | VM Apps Org - Deployment
sources.contract_facts: The requestId path parameter identifies the Request; a 200 response contains status. Documented values are CREATED, PENDING, INITIALIZATION, CHECKING_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_PENDING, USER_INTERACTION_PENDING, INPROGRESS, COMPLETION, APPROVAL_REJECTED, ABORTED, SUCCESSFUL and FAILED.
